title: Browser-backed Dresser MCP vertical slice
goal: An MCP client can discover the exact local Dresser mirror's supported preset values, submit one local screenshot with a versioned preset, and receive the absolute path and metadata for the PNG exported by that browser UI.

delivery.user_value: An agent can turn a local product screenshot into a presentation-ready Dresser PNG without manually operating the editor.

steps: Start the exact mirror from .local/dresser-mirror, a controlled Chrome session, and the local stdio MCP server.
Call dresser_get_capabilities and select supported device, background, mesh, and layout values from its versioned response.
Call dresser_render_png with one local PNG or JPEG and a dresser-preset/v1 preset, then verify the returned absolute artifact path opens as the PNG exported by Dresser.

unlocks: agent-driven screenshot-to-case asset generation through Dresser

work_classification.reason: This backend/tooling task exposes an existing editor flow and preset contract; it makes no screen-structure, navigation, or human interaction-flow decisions.

local.reason: The approved MVP slice is local-only and must not write lifecycle events to Discord or another external tracker.

reasons: The new MCP and browser boundary reads caller-selected local files, controls Chrome, and returns filesystem artifacts, but is loopback-only and reversible.

out: changes to any file or asset inside .local/dresser-mirror
changes to /tools/mockup or any portfolio interface
Figma ingestion, frame selection, multi-screen composition, batch rendering, video input, and video export
public or remote MCP transport, authentication, cloud storage, deployment, publication, and Git push
NDA isolation as a release gate for this redesign-phase MVP

constraints: Use the official MCP SDK over local stdio and keep the protocol contract independent from DOM selectors; package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and the task-owned test setup may change only for required MCP/runtime dependencies and scripts.

dresser_get_capabilities and dresser_render_png are the public MVP tools. Both expose dresser-preset/v1; capabilities return stable IDs, defaults, numeric bounds or enumerations, mirror manifest identity, and only values proven present in the live browser UI.

The dresser-preset/v1 schema is a closed, versioned object with device model/color IDs; a background union for solid color, explicit three-color mesh, transparent, and discovered built-in picture modes; and layout aspect-ratio ID, padding, device scale, and x/y position. Unknown properties, IDs, modes, non-finite numbers, and out-of-range values are rejected before browser mutation.

Render through a controlled Chrome/CDP page loaded from the loopback .local/dresser-mirror server; do not reimplement the composition renderer, call a remote Dresser site, inject caller-supplied JavaScript, or substitute a browser screenshot for Dresser's PNG export.

Canonicalize the source path, require a bounded regular PNG or JPEG whose content matches its declared type, and write only a new request-scoped .png under .local/dresser-mcp-output; never accept an arbitrary output path or overwrite an existing file.

Serialize browser mutations, start each render from a clean Dresser page state, apply every supplied field, wait for settled rendering and download completion with bounded timeouts, and return no artifact on partial or stale completion.

Keep the mirror and MCP endpoints on 127.0.0.1, preserve the mirror CSP/local-assets-only boundary, use an isolated disposable browser profile, and never log screenshot bytes, base64 media, full local source paths, credentials, or raw MCP/CDP payloads.

Preserve unrelated dirty-worktree changes. Do not edit generated dist files, .local/dresser-mirror, existing portfolio source, tasks/HISTORY.md, or perform Git push, deployment, publication, force-push, merge, tag, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Starting the local stdio server succeeds with the documented command and MCP tool discovery exposes exactly dresser_get_capabilities and dresser_render_png with machine-readable input/output schemas.

dresser_get_capabilities opens the exact .local/dresser-mirror in a controlled browser and returns dresser-preset/v1 metadata containing the mirror manifest identity plus discovered device models/colors, PNG-relevant background modes and values, mesh color contract, layout options, defaults, and bounds.

dresser_render_png accepts one valid local PNG or JPEG and a valid dresser-preset/v1 object, applies its device, background or three-color mesh, aspect ratio, padding, scale, and x/y settings in the browser UI, and invokes Dresser's own PNG export.

A successful render returns an absolute path under .local/dresser-mcp-output together with image/png, non-zero byte size, SHA-256, pixel width, and pixel height; the file exists, has a valid PNG signature, and visually reflects the requested preset.

Two sequential renders with materially different supported presets do not leak source media or settings between jobs, and simultaneous calls are serialized or rejected with a stable non-destructive busy error.

Missing or non-regular source paths, traversal attempts, spoofed or unsupported media, oversized files, schema violations, unknown capability IDs, out-of-range values, unavailable browser/mirror, render timeout, and failed download return bounded MCP errors without creating or reusing an artifact.

During capability discovery and rendering, browser traffic stays on loopback/blob/data URLs, screenshot bytes and full source paths do not appear in logs or MCP errors, and temporary browser/profile/download state is removed while the intentional final PNG remains.

Existing portfolio code and the exact .local/dresser-mirror remain unchanged, the interactive mirror still opens at /tools/mockup, task-scoped MCP lint, tests, build, and whitespace validation pass, and a fresh full-repository lint run reproduces only the same 10 pre-existing out-of-scope errors recorded at preflight as accepted MVP debt.

checks.description: Connect an MCP client over stdio, list the two tools, call dresser_get_capabilities against the live mirror, validate the response against its schema, and reconcile stable IDs/defaults/bounds with the controls actually present in that browser page.

Render a disposable screenshot once with solid background and once with explicit mesh colors plus different device/layout values; inspect returned metadata and both PNGs, and record that the browser used Dresser's export rather than Page.captureScreenshot.

Exercise missing/directory/traversal/spoofed/unsupported/oversized sources, malformed or unknown presets, unavailable CDP/mirror, timeout, and failed download; each must produce a stable non-leaking MCP error and no stale or partial artifact.
Run sequential distinct jobs and overlapping calls; confirm clean-page reset, no media/settings bleed, deterministic serialization or busy behavior, unique output names, and no overwrite.

Capture network, stdout/stderr, MCP errors, and temporary filesystem state during import/export; confirm loopback/blob/data-only traffic, redacted source identity, no media payload logging, and cleanup of disposable browser state.
Open the mirror interactively at /tools/mockup and inspect scoped Git diff; confirm mirror files, existing portfolio routes, and TASK-MOCKUP-001-owned editor code are unchanged.

Run pnpm lint and compare its complete findings with preflight-lint.log; accept the non-zero result only when it reproduces exactly the same 10 errors in the same five out-of-scope files and reports no new or task-owned MCP lint finding.

steps: Remove only TASK-MOCKUP-MCP-001-owned files under server/mockup-mcp and revert only its package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml dependency/script additions.
Delete disposable .local/dresser-mcp-output test artifacts, then rerun pnpm lint and pnpm build to confirm the pre-task application remains intact.
data_recovery: No source data migration exists; caller screenshots are read-only and generated PNGs are disposable local artifacts.

visual_gate.reason: This task adds a local MCP/browser automation boundary and does not change any product interface or make UX-flow decisions.

evidence_required: solid and mesh PNG demo artifacts with hashes and dimensions
negative input, preset, CDP, mirror, timeout, and download results
network, log-redaction, and temporary-state cleanup evidence
task-scoped MCP lint, build, test, mirror-integrity, and diff-check logs plus unchanged full-repository lint debt
scoped diff and neighbor regression report

history.summary: Compile a browser-backed local MCP that turns a screenshot and versioned Dresser preset into a PNG artifact.
